methodology: Only public official provider pages are used as evidence. Amounts are maximum advertised amounts or clearly labeled free allocations, not guarantees.

programs.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program — AI
programs.benefit: Up to US$350,000 in Google Cloud credits for eligible AI startups, with technical resources and support.
programs.duration: Stage/tier dependent; the broader program describes a two-year credit window.
programs.payment_note: Review account and billing terms before enabling any paid billing.
programs.caution: The advertised maximum is not a guaranteed award; AI/startup stage and review determine the actual package.

programs.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program — pre-funded MVP
programs.benefit: US$2,000 in credits for pre-funded founders building an MVP.
programs.duration: MVP program terms
programs.payment_note: Confirm whether the account requires payment verification in your region.
programs.caution: Use the pre-funded track only if that description is factually accurate for the applicant.

programs.name: AWS Activate Credits
programs.benefit: Eligible startups can apply for packages ranging from US$1,000 to US$200,000 in AWS Activate Credits.
programs.duration: Package-specific; see the current Activate terms.
eligibility: self-funded Founders or Activate Provider Portfolio route
programs.payment_note: AWS accounts and paid services have separate billing terms; configure spend alerts before use.
programs.caution: Provider/accelerator Org IDs are not public coupons. Never use an unrelated or shared code.

programs.name: Microsoft for Startups
programs.benefit: Access to Azure and startup resources, with approved startups eligible for up to US$150,000 in credits.
programs.duration: Tier and account terms
programs.payment_note: Do not accept a paid plan or activate billable services without checking the credit boundary.
programs.caution: The application page describes starter credits and progressive approval; the maximum is not automatic.

programs.name: Azure for Startups — instant and verified credits
programs.benefit: US$1,000 in Azure credits instantly for eligible new customers, with up to US$5,000 after business verification.
programs.duration: Initial credits 90 days; post-verification credits 180 days per the official page.
eligibility: startup/business verification for the expanded amount
programs.payment_note: The official page says a credit card is required for identity verification and services beyond the credit.
programs.caution: This is distinct from the larger Microsoft for Startups program; do not assume the two offers stack.

programs.name: DigitalOcean Hatch for AI/ML startups
programs.benefit: Qualified Hatch participants may receive up to US$100,000 in compute credits plus startup support.
programs.duration: Hatch program terms; the program is described as a 12-month startup program.
programs.payment_note: Set a spending limit and review any support or account terms before creating compute resources.
programs.caution: Admission and credit amount are conditional; partner perks shown on the welcome kit are separate offers.

programs.name: NVIDIA Inception
programs.benefit: Free startup membership with access to member-only partner offers, including cloud credits, developer tools, and training.
programs.duration: Membership and partner-offer terms
programs.payment_note: Partner credits are requested through the member portal and may have separate approval rules.
programs.caution: NVIDIA does not publish one universal credit amount on the public membership page; treat partner benefits as variable.

programs.name: Google Cloud Free Program
programs.benefit: New customers receive US$300 in free credit and access to 20+ products with free monthly limits.
programs.duration: Trial period and free-tier limits are account/product specific.
programs.payment_note: Payment verification may be requested. Do not activate the full paid account until the user confirms.
programs.caution: Free monthly limits are separate from the trial credit and can change.

programs.name: AWS Free Tier
programs.benefit: New customers can receive up to US$200 in credits and use selected AWS services on the Free plan for up to six months.
programs.duration: Free plan up to six months; credit expiry is governed by the current terms.
programs.payment_note: Account registration may request payment verification; free-plan terms say charges require an upgrade or paid-only action.
programs.caution: Read the current Free Tier terms and never open duplicate accounts to extend an offer.

programs.name: Oracle Cloud Free Tier
programs.benefit: US$300 trial credit for up to 30 days plus Always Free services with no time limit, subject to capacity and service limits.
programs.duration: Trial up to 30 days; Always Free services continue subject to their limits.
programs.payment_note: Oracle says many new users provide a card for identification; do not upgrade to paid without confirmation.
programs.caution: Always Free compute is region-bound and may be capacity constrained; choose the home region carefully.

programs.name: Azure Free Services
programs.benefit: Free monthly amounts across 65+ always-free services and additional services free for 12 months for eligible new customers.
programs.duration: Always-free or 12 months depending on the service.
programs.payment_note: Some account types require verification; always check how the selected service handles overages.
programs.caution: Free service amounts are product-specific and can change; free control-plane operations may still incur node/resource charges.

programs.name: Azure for Students
programs.benefit: US$100 Azure credit for 12 months, plus free services; no credit card required for eligible full-time university students.
programs.duration: Credit for 12 months; annual renewal while eligible.
programs.payment_note: The official page states no credit card is required; do not submit an academic identity that is not yours.
programs.caution: Student status, school-domain recognition, and region rules are checked by Microsoft. The global Azure offer and Azure operated by 21Vianet are separate environments; use the actual region shown during signup and never substitute a foreign address.

programs.name: Oracle Academy Cloud Program
programs.benefit: Member educators and students can receive US$300 of cloud credits for one year for prototyping and learning.
programs.duration: One year per the official Oracle Academy page.
eligibility: Oracle Academy member educator or student
programs.payment_note: Use only for eligible academic activity and review account terms before provisioning resources.
programs.caution: This is not a general-purpose startup coupon; academic eligibility is required.

programs.name: Gemini Developer API Free Tier
programs.benefit: Selected Gemini API models have a free tier for developers and small projects; limits vary by model and account.
programs.duration: Quota and model availability are subject to current pricing and limits.
requirements: Google AI Studio or API account
programs.payment_note: The pricing page distinguishes free and paid tiers; do not attach billing unless needed and confirmed.
programs.caution: The free tier may allow Google to use inputs/outputs to improve products; review the current privacy controls before sending sensitive data.

programs.name: Mistral API Free Mode
programs.benefit: Free mode lets users create API keys and use included monthly API usage within the limits shown in the Mistral console.
programs.amount_display: Included monthly usage; limits shown in console
programs.duration: Monthly included usage; limits can change.
programs.payment_note: Pay-as-you-go is separate; do not enable it for a prototype without a spend limit.
programs.caution: Mistral does not promise one universal public quota on the limits page; use the account's current limits.

programs.name: Groq API Free Tier
programs.benefit: Free-tier inference with provider rate limits; exact organization limits are shown in the current Groq account.
programs.duration: While the free tier and model availability remain offered.
requirements: respect rate limits and model lifecycle
programs.payment_note: The official FAQ says a payment method is needed to upgrade to the paid Developer tier.
programs.caution: Free-tier model deprecations and quotas change; pin models only after checking the current deprecation page.

programs.name: Cohere Evaluation API Key
programs.benefit: Free evaluation keys with limited usage for testing Cohere APIs.
programs.duration: Evaluation-key terms and quotas
programs.payment_note: Production keys are separate from free evaluation keys; do not add billing unless confirmed.
programs.caution: Evaluation keys are for limited testing, not an entitlement to production capacity.

programs.name: Free Models Router
programs.benefit: A unified API can route requests to free model variants or the free router; availability and rate limits are low/variable.
programs.duration: Free-model availability and account limits vary.
requirements: use :free variants or the free router
programs.payment_note: Do not purchase credits just to raise free-model limits; use the free router for low-volume prototypes.
programs.caution: Free model selection, latency, and availability can change; this is not a production SLA.

programs.name: Workers AI Free Allocation
programs.benefit: Workers Free includes 10,000 Neurons per day at no charge; limits reset daily and some models require a paid billing method.
programs.duration: Daily allocation, reset at 00:00 UTC.
requirements: choose a model covered by the free allocation
programs.payment_note: The official page lists models that require a paid billing method; check before selecting one.
programs.caution: Neurons measure model-dependent compute; do not translate them into a fixed token quota.

programs.name: Spaces ZeroGPU
programs.benefit: Existing ZeroGPU Spaces are free to use; free personal accounts in good standing can host up to two ZeroGPU Spaces after email/account-age checks.
programs.amount_display: Free shared GPU quota; queue/usage limited
programs.duration: Quota and queue priority depend on account type and current platform policy.
eligibility: verified email and account older than 30 days to host
requirements: public Space or compatible Gradio app
programs.payment_note: PRO increases quota/priority; do not subscribe solely to obtain a prototype GPU unless confirmed.
programs.caution: ZeroGPU is shared and queue-based; it is suitable for demos and small experiments, not guaranteed training capacity.

programs.name: Google Colab Free Compute
programs.benefit: Free access to compute resources including GPUs and TPUs for notebook experimentation, subject to availability and usage limits.
programs.duration: Availability and runtime limits are dynamic.
programs.payment_note: Paid Colab plans are optional; do not upgrade without explicit confirmation.
programs.caution: Free accelerators are not guaranteed and sessions can be interrupted.

programs.name: Kaggle Notebooks GPU
programs.benefit: Kaggle notebooks provide free GPU environments for experimentation; the current docs describe adding a single NVIDIA Tesla P100 at no cost.
programs.duration: Notebook quota and availability are platform controlled.
programs.payment_note: No paid upgrade is needed for the documented free notebook path; quotas still apply.
programs.caution: Treat hardware type and quota as changeable; verify the accelerator shown in the current notebook UI.

programs.name: GitHub Codespaces Free Plan
programs.benefit: Free-plan users receive 120 core hours or 60 hours on a 2-core Codespace plus 15 GB storage each month.
programs.duration: Monthly quota
programs.payment_note: Codespaces can become billable after the free quota; set spending limits before long-running sessions.
programs.caution: Codespaces is development compute, not a GPU grant or production hosting commitment.
